db_assertions.db_subject: CATH-2-derived antimicrobial peptide inhibits multidrug-resistant Escherichia coli infection in chickens.
db_assertions.db_measure: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (93.33%) to CATH-2(1-15) R: 33%, F: 20%, I=K: 13%. Activity: active against E. coli ATCC 8739 or 6 resistant E strains (MIC 0.5-16 ug/ml). Warning: other bacteria not tested. In vitro toxicity: chicken RBC: 30% hemolysis at 64 ug/ml. At this concentration, 40% chicken kidney cells survived.

db_assertions.db_subject: CATH-2-derived antimicrobial peptide inhibits multidrug-resistant Escherichia coli infection in chickens.
db_assertions.db_measure: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (86.67%) to CATH-2(1-15) R: 40%, F=I=K: 13%. FRP segment was repalced by MRL. Activity: active against E. coli ATCC 8739 or 6 resistant E strains (MIC 2-8 ug/ml). Warning: other bacteria not tested. In vitro toxicity: chicken RBC: ~10% hemolysis at 64 ug/ml (slightly hemo.lytic). At this concentration, nearly all chicken kidney cells survived. Animal model:chicken: 21-day-old infected with E. coli via the pectoral muscle, 4h later, treated via the same route. Showed efficacy (treatment 70% survial vs. 30% survival no treatment; and CFU drop in organs such as liver, heart, and spleen). This peptide may be utilized to treat avian colibacillosis caused by E. coli.
